partnershipPlan: The older adults' advisory group reviews the reminder wording and the peer call script; two peer volunteers help design the volunteer training.
socialListening: No social media listening; programme feedback forms from last year are read for reasons people stopped attending.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I missed a week with a cold and then felt too embarrassed to go back.
items.implication: Call within three days of any missed week.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase (peer volunteer): I know how hard week six was for me, so I can say it gets easier.
items.implication: Time the peer calls around weeks 3 and 8.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: My father has a landline and a hearing aid; a text would never reach him.
items.implication: Phone calls as the default for people without a mobile phone.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase (instructor): I can glance at a calendar at the start of class, but I cannot chase people.
items.implication: Keep instructors out of reminders and calls.

summary: Four composite voices on missed weeks, peer support, phone access and instructor workload.
